x-e-m3-07.thinking.0: Chọta echiche zoro ezo n'ime nkwupụta
x-e-m3-07.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”
x-e-m3-07.goal: Chọpụta echiche a na-ekwughị nke dị mkpa ka nkwupụta wee bụrụ eziokwu, dee nkọwa ọzọ n’asụsụ Bekee nke na-eme ka echiche ahụ maa jijiji.
x-e-m3-07.material:
E tinyere nke a n’elu bọọdụ n’ihu cafeteria ụlọ akwụkwọ.

“This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu.”
x-e-m3-07.thinking.1: Ịtụ aro nkọwa ọzọ na ozi a ga-enyocha
x-e-m3-07.prereq.0: Ahịrịokwu na-enye ihe kpatara ya site na because na so
x-e-m3-07.prereq.1: Okwu na-egosi ohere site na maybe na could
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.prompt: Ka nkwubi okwu “Cafeteria rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe. Ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ enweghị mmasị na menu ọhụrụ” wee bụrụ eziokwu, echiche dị aṅaa a na-ekwughị ka achọrọ?
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee n’asụsụ nke gị ihe nwere ike ịkpata “ere nri ehihie pere mpe.”
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.hint.1: Maka nhọrọ nke ọ bụla, jụọ ma ọ na-emetụta nkwubi okwu, ma ọ bụ eziokwu.
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.r.a: Ihe menu nwere adịghị emetụta nkwubi okwu a ozugbo. A chọrọ echiche na-akọwa ihe mere ọnụ ọgụgụ ire ji daa.
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.r.b: Naanị ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ na ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ hà ka a pụrụ ikwu na ọdịiche ire bụ n’ihi uto nri.
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.r.c: A naghị eji ewu ewu menu ochie tụnyere ọnụ ọgụgụ ire nke ọnwa a na nke gara aga.
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụ ọgụgụ nlekọta e tinyere n’isi nri enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na nkwubi okwu. Ọ naghị akọwa ihe kpatara ọdịiche ahịa.
x-e-m3-07.s.s1.explain: Iji si n’eziokwu na ahịa dara gaa “uto nri adabaghị ha,” ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ, wdg) ga-abụ otu. Ọ bụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ pere mpe, ahịa ga-ada ọbụna ma uto nri adịghị agbanwe.
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.prompt: Chee ihe ọzọ kpatara ahịa ji daa, dee ya n’asụsụ Bekee; dee kwa n’otu ahịrịokwu ihe a ga-amata iji lelee ma ihe kpatara ya ziri ezi.
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dee n’asụsụ Korean ihe abụọ nwere ike gbanwee n’etiti ọnwa gara aga na nke a (ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị, mmemme).
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ otu n’ime ha, dee ya n’asụsụ Bekee site na “Maybe ... because ...”
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ: Maybe sales were lower because ... We need to know ...
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ihe kpatara i nyere ọ̀ bụ nkọwa ọzọ na-abụghị “ha enweghị mmasị na menu ọhụrụ”?
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ozi a ga-enyocha ọ̀ metụtara ihe kpatara gị? (dịka ịtụnyere ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ)
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ihe kpatara gị ọ̀ bụ ahịrịokwu a pụrụ ịlele, ọ bụghị amụma otu ugboro naanị?
x-e-m3-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: O nyere ihe kpatara dị iche, njem ọmụmụ.

x-e-m3-04.thinking.0: Imegharị ikpe gị site n’ozi ọhụrụ
x-e-m3-04.title: Gbanwee nhọrọ ụlọ nri ka nkọwa ọzọ na-apụta otu n'otu
x-e-m3-04.goal: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.
x-e-m3-04.material: Otu ezinụlọ na-ahọrọ ụlọ nri maka nri ehihie tupu ihe nkiri (na-amalite na 3:00 p.m.). Oge nri ehihie bụ otu awa malite na 12:30. Ozi nkọwa na-apụta otu n'otu.
x-e-m3-04.thinking.1: Mee nchịkọta nke ọnọdụ ọkwa a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi
x-e-m3-04.prereq.0: Ihe okwu dị ka stars (ọkwa) na review pụtara
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.prompt: Gụọ ozi ahụ otu akụkụ n’otu oge, kpebie ma ị ga-ahọrọ ụlọ oriri a maka nri ehihie ezinụlọ.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Chọta otu okwu ma ọ bụ nọmba ị na-ahụ na nke mbụ n’akụkụ a.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tulee mkpebi mbụ gị na ozi ọhụrụ otu otu.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Site n’ozi a naanị, echiche kacha nwee ezi uche banyere ịhọrọ ụlọ oriri a bụ nke gịnị?
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ọbụna ma ọkwa ahụ dị elu, nyocha 3 naanị pụtara “ọ dị mma n’ile anya.” A chọrọ ozi ọzọ.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nyocha ole na ole apụtaghị na ọ dị njọ; ọ pụtara naanị na anyị amaghị ugbu a.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ọkwa kpakpando dị elu, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ nyocha dị mkpa. O siri ike inwe ntụkwasị obi site n’echiche mmadụ 3 naanị.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ọ na-atụle ma ọkwa kpakpando dị mma ma ọnụ ọgụgụ nyocha dị obere.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mgbe ị hụrụ ozi ọhụrụ ahụ, olee otú i kwesịrị isi were ọkwa 4.8?
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Nyocha nwere otu ahịrịokwu ahụ e tinyere n’otu ụbọchị ahụ adịghị ka echiche onwe onye nke ndị dị iche. Ntụkwasị obi n’ọkwa ahụ belatara.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Nọmba ahụ bụ otu, ma ntụkwasị obi na nyocha ndị mepụtara nọmba ahụ agbanweela.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ọ jikọtara ahịrịokwu ndị yiri otu na ihe ngosi ụbọchị mmeghe, mee ka ọ bụrụ ihe a na-enyo enyo.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ị pụghị ịhụ mmekọrịta dị n’etiti nyocha ụbọchị mmeghe na ịdị ọhụrụ nri. Njikọ ya na ihe ngosi adịghị ike.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ezinụlọ ahụ ga-abịa na 12:30, ga-agwụkwa iri nri tupu 1:30. Gịnị ka ha kwesịrị ime ugbu a?
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Mgbe nyocha mụbara, ozi doro anya pụtara, oge ichere. Ijikọta ya na ọnọdụ gị (awa 1) na-eduga n’ikpebi idebe tebụl ma ọ bụ họrọ ebe ọzọ.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ọ na-atụle ozi oge ichere dị na nyocha ahụ na oke oge nke m.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ọ hụrụ naanị na nọmba ahụ gbadara. O tụleghị na ha bụ echiche ndị mmadụ karịa.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ọkwa kpakpando dị elu, ma o leleghị “ichere nkeji 40” nke nyocha kwuru megide oke oge nke m.
x-e-m3-04.s.s1.reflect: Site na mkpebi mbụ gị ruo na nke ikpeazụ, ozi ọhụrụ dị aṅaa gbanwere ya? Kwuo otu ihe i tụkwasịrị obi karịa nọmba ọkwa.
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.prompt: Mezue ahịrịokwu bidoro “Ọkwa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na-atụkwasị obi karịa mgbe ...” dee ọnọdụ ọkwa a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi n’asụsụ Bekee.
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Chee ozi kacha mụbara ntụkwasị obi gị n’oge e kpughere ihe.
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jikọta “a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa mgbe ...” site na when.
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ: A restaurant rating is more reliable when ...
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ọnọdụ i dere ọ̀ metụtara ozi i hụrụ n’oge ngosi (ọnụọgụ nyocha, otu ahịrịokwu, oge ichere)?
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ọnọdụ gị abụghị naanị ikwughachi “ọkwa dị elu”?
x-e-m3-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: O nyere ịbụ kpọmkwem dịka otu ọnọdụ.

x-e-m3-09.title: Degharịa otu ọkwa ahụ maka ụmụ akwụkwọ nta na maka nne na nna
x-e-m3-09.goal: Degharịa otu ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ site n’iji okwu na ozi dị iche dịka onye na-agụ si dị (ụmụ akwụkwọ elementrị obere, nne na nna).
x-e-m3-09.material:
Nke a bụ ọkwa maka ngosi sayensị ụlọ akwụkwọ (maka ndị nkuzi).

“Students must submit project proposals to their homeroom teacher by October 20. Late proposals will not be accepted. Projects will be displayed in the gym on November 3 from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m. Parents are welcome to attend.”
x-e-m3-09.thinking.1: Ịkwado okwu na ụda onye na-agụ
x-e-m3-09.prereq.0: Otu esi ede ọnwa na ụbọchị n’asụsụ Bekee (Nov. 3)
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ kacha dabara iji degharịa ahịrịokwu abụọ mbụ ka nwa akwụkwọ klaasị nke atọ gụọ ma soro ha ozugbo, n’enweghị okwu siri ike?
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.hint.0: N’ime nhọrọ nke ọ bụla, kaa ma “ihe a ga-eme, ụbọchị, ihe ga-eme ma oge gafere” ka dị.
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee iche ma okwu nwa afọ 10 na-amaghị ka fọdụrụ.
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.r.a: O debere ọrụ, ụbọchị, na ihe ga-eme ma oge gafere, jiri okwu dị mfe niile.
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị mkpirikpi karịa, mana okwu siri ike dịka proposals, due, na accepted ka dị otu.
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.r.c: Okwu siri ike ka dị, ụbọchị kpọmkwem apụla.
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị mfe ma dị ọbụbụenyi, ma ụbọchị na nsonaazụ ịbịaghị n'oge apụọla.
x-e-m3-09.s.s1.explain: Mgbe onye na-agụ bụ nwa akwụkwọ dị obere, gbanwee okwu ka ha bụrụ ndị dị mfe ma debe ihe a ga-eme (inye echiche), ụbọchị (Ọktoba 20), na ihe na-eme ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bịa mgbe e mesịrị. d dị mfe ma dị ọbụbụenyi, ma ụbọchị na nsonaazụ ịbịaghị n'oge apụọla, ma b na c debere okwu siri ike dị ka proposals, due, na submit.
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.prompt: Ugbu a dee oku ahịrị okwu abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ n'asụsụ Bekee nye ndị nne na nna. Gụnye ụbọchị, oge, na ebe, ma kpọọ ha n'ụzọ dị mma.
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kee ihe niile ndị nne na nna kwesịrị ịmara n'ahịrị okwu abụọ ikpeazụ nke ọkwa ahụ.
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.hint.1: Malite site na Dear parents, ma dee ebe na ụbọchị n'otu ahịrị okwu na oge n'ahịrị okwu na-esote.
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.placeholder: Ihe atụ: Dear parents, you are invited to ...
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ụbọchị, oge, na ebe niile ziri ezi?
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị gbanwere 'Parents are welcome' ka ọ bụrụ ụda oku?
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ụda ahụ dị iche na ọkwa maka ụmụ akwụkwọ dị obere?
x-e-m3-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ dere oge dị ka 1 p.m. ruo 3 p.m.

x-e-m3-01.title: Dozie ahịrịokwu ihe kpatara nke na-apụ n'isiokwu n'ederede echiche
x-e-m3-01.goal: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu ọ bụla dị n'ederede echiche na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ, chọta ahịrịokwu na-adabaghị, ma dee ya ọzọ dị ka ahịrịokwu ihe kpatara nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
x-e-m3-01.material: N'klaasị Bekee, otu nwa akwụkwọ dere ederede echiche banyere 'Should school start later?' A dere ahịrịokwu ọ bụla n'ahịrị nke ya.
x-e-m3-01.thinking.0: Lelee otú ahịrịokwu ọ bụla si metụta nkwupụta ahụ
x-e-m3-01.thinking.1: Chọta ihe kpatara nke na-adabaghị ma dozie ya
x-e-m3-01.prereq.0: Okwu njikọ dị mfe na-egosi ihe kpatara, dị ka because na so
x-e-m3-01.prereq.1: Ahịrịokwu Bekee na-enye echiche na I think ...
x-e-m3-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ otu ahịrị dị n'ederede echiche a nke na-akwadoghị nkwupụta ahụ.
x-e-m3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, dee otu okwu maka otú o si metụta nkwupụta 'School should start later' (nkwupụta/ihe kpatara/nkwubi okwu/ihe ọzọ).
x-e-m3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, jụọ: 'Ọ bụrụ na ahịrịokwu a bụ eziokwu, ọ̀ bụ ihe kpatara ịgbanwe oge mmalite?'
x-e-m3-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 4 bụ banyere nri ọsụsọ jụrụ oyi, ya mere ọ nweghị njikọ na oge mmalite ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ahịrị 2 na 3 na-akwado nkwupụta site na 'ike gwụrụ -> o siri ike ilekwasị anya.' Ahịrị 1 bụ nkwupụta, ma ahịrị 5 bụ nkwubi okwu.
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.prompt: Hichapụ ahịrịokwu ị họọrọ, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee otu ahịrịokwu na-akwado otu nkwupụta ahụ (School should start later).
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chee otu ụzọ mmalite oge ọzọ ga-esi gbanwee ụtụtụ nwa akwụkwọ n'asụsụ Korea.
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dee otu ihe ahụ n'otu ahịrịokwu Bekee. Ị nwere ike ịmalite na "Also, ..." ma ọ bụ malite n'ụzọ dị iche.
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ahịrịokwu ọhụrụ gị ọ̀ na-ekwu ihe dị mma banyere ịmalite mgbe e mesịrị, ma ọ bụ nsogbu na-esite n'ịmalite n'oge?
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị tinyere ihe kpatara ọhụrụ na-enweghị ikwugharị otu ihe ahụ dị n'ahịrị 2 na 3 nke ederede mbụ?
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ahịrịokwu gị bụ otu ahịrịokwu Bekee zuru ezu?
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ nyere ihe kpatara dị iche, nri ụtụtụ.
x-e-m3-01.s.s2.modelNote.2: Ọ na-akwado otu nkwupụta ahụ site n'ịkọwa nsogbu na-ebilite mgbe e bidoro n'oge.

x-e-m3-02.title: Dee ederede echiche nke m: ihe kpatara na azịza nye akụkụ nke ọzọ
x-e-m3-02.goal: Kpebie ọnọdụ gị, ma dee obere ederede echiche n'asụsụ Bekee nwere ihe kpatara na azịza nye echiche na-emegide.
x-e-m3-02.material: N'klaasị Bekee ị gụrụ nkwupụta 'Students should have a short break between classes.' Ịchọrọ ịkwenye enyi na-ekwenyeghị na nkwupụta a.
x-e-m3-02.thinking.0: Họrọ ihe akaebe bara uru maka ịkwenye mmadụ
x-e-m3-02.thinking.1: Tụọ anya echiche na-emegide ma zaa ya
x-e-m3-02.prereq.1: Okwu njikọ dị mfe dị ka but na however
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.prompt: Iji kwenye enyi na-ekwenyeghị na nkwupụta a, kedu n'ime ihe akaebe ndị a ga-abara uru kachasị?
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, kọwaa onye na-ekwu ya, mmadụ ole, na ihe a na-ekwu na-eme.
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Chee echiche ma enyi na-ekwenyeghị nwere ike ịnụ nke a ma jụọ, 'N'ezie?'
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ejikọta omume (ino mmiri, izu ike) na nsonaazụ (nlekwasị anya), ya mere ọbụlagodi onye na-ekwenyeghị nwere ike ilele ya.
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.r.b: "Everybody wants it" dabere n'ịma ama. Ọ naghị agwa enyi na-ekwenyeghị ihe mere o ji dị mma.
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.r.c: "Very good" bụ okwu siri ike, ma ọ naghị akọwa ihe dị mma na otú.
x-e-m3-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dabere n'onye kwuru ya. Ọ naghị akọwa ọdịnaya n'onwe ya.

x-e-m3-03.title: Họrọ nke n'ime nkọwa atọ ga-eji dị ka ihe akaebe maka mkpebi ịzụrụ ihe
x-e-m3-03.goal: N'etiti nkọwa atọ, họrọ ọdịnaya nwere ike ịbụ ihe akaebe maka mkpebi ịzụrụ ihe, ma dee ndụmọdụ kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ n'asụsụ Bekee.
x-e-m3-03.material:
Hana na-aga ịzụta karama mmiri ọ ga-eji na ọzụzụ bọl ụkwụ n'oge ọkọchị. Ọ gụrụ nkọwa atọ banyere "Mino Bottle" na weebụsaịtị ịzụ ahịa n'ịntanetị.

Review A (5 stars): "Best bottle ever! I love it so much. Everyone should buy it!"

Review B (4 stars): "It kept my water cold from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. I put in ice, and some was still left. The cap is a little hard to open. After I dropped it twice, the paint came off."

Review C (1 star): "Very bad. The box came three days late, and the delivery man was rude."
x-e-m3-03.thinking.1: Họrọ ihe akaebe kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ma kpebie
x-e-m3-03.prereq.0: Okwu nkọwa dị mfe dị ka good, cold na hard
x-e-m3-03.prereq.1: Ịmara ihe kpakpando dị n'nkọwa bụ
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe kpatara kacha mma Review B ji baa uru karịa Review A maka ime mkpebi ịzụrụ ihe?
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.hint.0: N'nkọwa ọ bụla, kọwaa n'iche eziokwu doro anya (oge, ọnọdụ ihe ahụ) na okwu mmetụta.
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Chee echiche ma ike B na-anọgide ma ị wepụ ọkwa kpakpando, ogologo, ma ọ bụ ịkpọ nsogbu, otu n'otu.
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọkwa kpakpando dị ala abụghị nke ziri ezi karịa. A pụkwara ide ọkwa dị ala na-enweghị ihe akaebe.
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo naanị anaghị agwa gị ozi ole dị. Nkọwa ogologo nwere ike ịnwe naanị mmetụta.
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.r.c: Ịkpọ nsogbu anaghị eme ka ihe akaebe dị mma. Ihe nsogbu ahụ bụ dị mkpa.
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ekwu ihe mere, ya mere onye na-azụ ahịa nwere ike itụnyere ya na ọnọdụ nke ya.
x-e-m3-03.s.s1.explain: B na-akọ ihe mere, dị ka oge (8 a.m. ruo 2 p.m.), ice, cap, na paint, ya mere ị nwere ike itụnyere ya na ọnọdụ gị. A nwere naanị mmetụta. Ọkwa kpakpando dị ala ma ọ bụ nkọwa ogologo anaghị ekwe nkwa ogo ihe akaebe.
x-e-m3-03.s.s2.prompt: Hana chọrọ karama mmiri maka ọzụzụ bọl ụkwụ (ehihie niile) n'oge ọkọchị. Dabere n'nkọwa ndị ahụ, dee ahịrịokwu abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ nke ndụmọdụ n'asụsụ Bekee. Gụnye ma ọ ga-azụ ya ma ọ bụ ọ gaghị azụ, nkọwa nke ọdịnaya ọ dabere na ya, na otu ihe ị ka chọrọ ịmara.
x-e-m3-03.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu ọdịnaya dị na B nke metụtara ọzụzụ bọl ụkwụ.
x-e-m3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Dee otu ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla banyere ma ọ dị mma ịzụta n'ihi ọdịnaya ahụ, na ma e nwere ihe ọ bụla ga-echegbu.

x-e-m3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị kwuru ọdịnaya dị n'nkọwa ndị ahụ nke ikpe gị sitere na ya?
x-e-m3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị zere iji nkọwa na-enweghị ozi, dị ka A ma ọ bụ C, dị ka ihe akaebe gị?
x-e-m3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ihe ị ka chọrọ ịmara ọ̀ jikọtara na ikpe gị?
x-e-m3-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ kpebiri ịzụghị ma sachaa nkọwa ndị na-enweghị ihe akaebe.

x-e-m3-05.material:
Jiho agaghị aga mmega band Friday, ya mere o zigara enyi ya Mina ozi a.

“hey mina! cant come 2 band practice on fri. got a fever lol. tell ms. park pls. thx!!”

Ugbu a Jiho chọrọ izigara Ms. Park email ozugbo.
x-e-m3-05.thinking.0: Ịmata ihe a ga-agbanwe na nke a ga-edebe dịka onye na-agụ si dị
x-e-m3-05.prereq.0: Ụdị akwụkwọ ozi na-amalite na Dear ...
x-e-m3-05.prereq.1: Ide contractions dịka can’t na won’t n’uju
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ akụkụ niile kwesịrị ịgbanwe n’ime email nye Ms. Park.
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa akụkụ nke ọ bụla “ụda” na “ozi.” Ozi dị aṅaa ka onye nkuzi chọrọ?

x-e-m3-05.s.s1.r.b: Ihe kpatara ya bụ ozi onye nkuzi kwesịrị ịma. Ụdị ya nwere ike ịgbanwe, mana ọdịnaya ga-adịgide.
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.o.c: Arịrịọ “tell ms. park” (ịrịọ ka e zigara Mina ozi n’aha ya)
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.r.d: Mkpopụta mkpirikpi adabaghị ederede nwere usoro. A ga-agbanwe ha ka ọ bụrụ mkpopụta ziri ezi.
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.r.e: Ụbọchị bụ ozi onye nkuzi kwesịrị ịma.
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.r.f: Okwu ọchị na ọtụtụ akara mkpu adabaghị ụda ederede nwere usoro.
x-e-m3-05.s.s1.explain: Ihe a ga-agbanwe bụ ụzọ e si ekwu okwu (ekele, mkpopụta mkpirikpi, lol na akara mkpu) na arịrịọ (“tell ms. park”), nke na-adabaghị idegara onye nkuzi ozugbo. Ihe kpatara ya (oyi) na ụbọchị (Friday) bụkwa ozi onye nkuzi chọrọ, ya mere ha ga-adịgide.
x-e-m3-05.s.s2.prompt: Were ọrụ Jiho, dee isi email nye Ms. Park n’asụsụ Bekee. Tinye ekele, ihe kpatara na ị gaghị abịa na ụbọchị, mgbaghara ma ọ bụ arịrịọ, mmechi, na aha gị.
x-e-m3-05.s.s2.hint.0: Gbanwee akụkụ nke ọ bụla ị họọrọ na s1 ka ọ bụrụ okwu i nwere ike iji.
x-e-m3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dee otu ahịrị n’otu oge n’usoro a: ekele → ihe kpatara na ụbọchị → mgbaghara ma ọ bụ arịrịọ → mmechi.
x-e-m3-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I jiri ụdị ịkpọ aha na mmechi dabara onye nkuzi?
x-e-m3-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị hapụghị ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ụbọchị?

x-e-m3-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ gbakwunyere akụkọ banyere dọkịta ka ihe kpatara ya doo anya karịa.

x-e-m3-06.material:
Jieun hụrụ ọkwa asọmpi ikwu okwu Bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ ya.

“Hanbit-gu English Speaking Contest. Open to students in Grades 7-9 who attend a school in Hanbit-gu. Register by October 30. Ask Mr. Kim if you have questions.”

Jieun nọ na Grade 9 na Sunrise Middle School (ụlọ akwụkwọ dị na Hanbit-gu). Nke a bụ email Jieun dere.

Subject: Question
Dear Mr. Kim,
I want to join the speaking contest. Can I join?
Sincerely,
Jieun

x-e-m3-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi ọzọ email ahụ kwesịrị inwe ka Mr. Kim zaa “Can I join?” Họrọ naanị ihe achọrọ n’ezie.
x-e-m3-06.s.s1.hint.0: Chọta ahịrị “Open to ...” n’ọkwa, dee iche ihe ọnọdụ eligibility dabere na ya.

x-e-m3-06.s.s1.r.d: Ọkwa ahụ kwuru ebe ụlọ akwụkwọ dị (Hanbit-gu) dịka ọnọdụ, ya mere a ga-amata ya.
x-e-m3-06.s.s1.r.e: Ozi a na-enye onye na-agụ enweghị njikọ na eligibility.

x-e-m3-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee otu ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu Bekee abụọ ga-esochi “I want to join the speaking contest.” n’email. Nye Mr. Kim ozi dị mkpa gbasara Jieun n’ụzọ nwere usoro ka o nwee ike ịza.

x-e-m3-08.s.s1.hint.0: N’ahịrị ndị bụ ihe akaebe, gụọ “mmadụ ole” akụkọ ahụ gbasara.
